title: One Continuum Plan per Client Organisation — Continuum Backup & Recovery Account Structure
content:
**Clause.** A client organisation holds at most one Continuum plan, and every protected server, workstation and Microsoft 365 user is registered under it; a device can be protected only once. A new plan may be ordered only when the client holds no other Continuum plan whose status is ordered, seeding, active, suspended or notice given.

This clause governs the account structure of Continuum Backup & Recovery: the maximum number of Continuum plans per client organisation is 1, and the plan is the single register of everything the client protects.

## The clause broken down

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Limit | At most one Continuum plan per client organisation |
| Register | Every protected server, workstation and Microsoft 365 user is registered under that one plan |
| Device rule | A device can be protected only once |
| Condition for a new order | The client holds no other Continuum plan in any of the statuses ordered, seeding, active, suspended or notice given |
| Evidence | The client's existing Continuum plan records and their statuses, as the system records them before the order is placed |

## Plan statuses and the new-order condition

The new-order condition names five statuses. Statuses outside that list are cancelled (an order the client cancelled before seeding began) and closed (a plan that has ended).

| Status of the client's existing Continuum plan | Is it one of the five statuses named in the condition? |
|---|---|
| ordered | Yes |
| seeding | Yes |
| active | Yes |
| suspended | Yes |
| notice given | Yes |
| cancelled | No |
| closed | No |

A new plan may be ordered only when no other plan of the client sits in a "Yes" row. The condition is read from the client's own plan records, matched to the client ordering; what the client says about an earlier plan is not the evidence.

## Basis Q&A

**A client's earlier plan is recorded as active and the client asks for a second plan for another office. May a second plan be ordered?**
No. The client holds another Continuum plan whose status is active, which is one of the five named statuses; the devices of the other office are registered under the one plan the client holds.

**A client's only earlier plan is in notice given status, because the client gave notice. May a new plan be ordered while that notice is running?**
No. The notice given status is one of the five named statuses.

**A server is already protected under the client's plan. Can it be protected a second time?**
No. A device can be protected only once.
